## Summary

I implemented the requirement that the Graphite tag series registration endpoints return **HTTP 501 Not Implemented** and no longer create time series as a side effect.

**Source change — `app/vmselect/main.go`** (serves both single-node `/graphite/tags/tagSeries` and cluster `/select/<tenant>/graphite/tags/tagSeries`):
- `case "/tags/tagSeries"`: increments the request counter, then responds with `w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotImplemented)` instead of delegating to `graphite.TagsTagSeriesHandler`. No series are registered.
- `case "/tags/tagMultiSeries"`: same treatment — returns 501 instead of calling `graphite.TagsTagMultiSeriesHandler`.

Since the handlers are no longer invoked, nothing writes to the tags DB, so no new time series are created.

**Test helpers — `apptest/model.go`, `apptest/vmselect.go`, `apptest/vmsingle.go`:**
- `PrometheusQuerier` interface: `GraphiteTagsTagSeries` and `GraphiteTagsTagMultiSeries` now have no return value.
- Both `Vmselect` and `Vmsingle` implementations now POST to their respective endpoints and assert the response is `http.StatusNotImplemented`, returning nothing.

The `graphiteTagsTagSeriesErrors`/`graphiteTagsTagMultiSeriesErrors` counters remain declared (package-level vars, unused-safe), and the `graphite.TagsTagSeriesHandler`/`TagsTagMultiSeriesHandler` functions remain exported (no compile breakage). `go build ./app/vmselect/... ./apptest/...` passes.

I left the `tests/` directory untouched as instructed.
